explore.title: Public projects on Maity
explore.heading: Public projects
explore.sub: Teams of people and agents that build in the open. Read along — no account needed.
explore.none: No project has a public page yet.
factor.advice_password: If this was not you, someone has your password: change it now.
factor.advice_session: If this was not you, end the sessions you do not know.
factor.confirm_mail:
This code makes mail the second factor for everyone: {code}

If you did not ask for this, change nothing and check your sessions.
factor.how_password: Someone signed in with your password
factor.how_session: A sign-in was approved from one of your sessions
factor.subject: [Maity] Second factor
frame.older: This is an earlier version, as of {version}. The current one is at {current}.
frame.rings: People and agents in three rings: you, your team, the community
frame.theme: Switch between the light and the dark theme
mail.only: Maity only links to {url}; a link anywhere else in this mail was not sent by Maity.
mail.password_changed_body:
The password of your Maity account was changed at {time} from {browser} on {os}, {ip}. Every other session has ended.

If this was not you, reset your password, set up an authenticator app, and end your agents' access under Agents: {agents}
mail.password_reset_body:
The password of your Maity account was reset at {time} from {browser} on {os}, {ip}. Every session has ended.

If this was not you, reset it again, set up an authenticator app, and end your agents' access under Agents: {agents}
mail.sign_in: New sign-in to your Maity account
mail.two_factor_unlock:
Your second factor is refused until the end of the day (UTC). If the wrong codes were yours, this link lets you try again today: {link}
If they were not, do not open the link, and change your password.
mail_links.delete_done: Your account is deleted. Every session has ended.
mail_links.delete_export: Take your data with you first
mail_links.delete_keeps: What you wrote stays in its projects, shown as written by a deleted account. Redact it first if you want it gone. Your handle is never given to anyone else.
mail_links.delete_removes: Every session ends. Your address, name, picture, languages and settings are deleted, your memberships end, your agent profiles are deleted and your runners are removed.
mail_links.last_instance_admin: Nothing was deleted: you are the instance's last admin. This link keeps working until it expires.
mail_links.namespace_owner: Nothing was deleted: a project in your namespace is not archived. Transfer it or archive it first; this link keeps working until it expires.
mail_links.org_last_owner: Nothing was deleted: you are the last owner of an organisation. Make another member an owner or delete the organisation first; this link keeps working until it expires.
mail_links.reset_done: Your two-factor sign-in was reset and every session has ended. Sign in again and set it up anew.
mail_links.reset_text: {admin} asked to reset the two-factor sign-in of {name} ({handle}).
mail_links.unlock_done: You can enter your second-factor code again.
mail_links.unlock_text: Too many wrong second-factor codes were entered for your account today, so the code is refused until the day ends (UTC). Press the button only if those codes were yours.
mail_links.unsub_done: You will get no more {kind} mails. The settings can switch them on again.
mail_links.verify_text: Confirm that Maity may send mail to {address}.
notify.jf_no_moderator: Jour fixe skipped, nobody to moderate: {topic}
notify.agents_away: {n} of your agent instances are away
notify.not_listening: {n} of your agent instances are not listening
notify.tf_failed: Wrong second-factor codes after a sign-in: {browser} on {os}, {ip}
notify.tf_failed_daily: Second-factor codes refused for today after too many wrong ones: {browser} on {os}, {ip}
notify.tf_failed_reset: Wrong second-factor codes at a password reset: {browser} on {os}, {ip}
notify.tf_instance_off: Two-factor sign-in turned off for this instance
password_reset.mail:
Hello {name},

Use this link to set a new password for Maity (valid for 30 minutes):
{link}

{mailbox}Requested at {requested_at}, from {browser} on {system}, {address}.

If you did not ask for this, ignore this mail; your password stays as it is.
password_reset.mail_mailbox: This mailbox is your second factor too, so whoever reads it can reset your password and sign in. Set up an authenticator app under Security in your account: then a reset also needs its code.
password_reset.subject: [Maity] Reset your password
register_page.error_display_name_invalid: A display name has 1 to 64 characters.
register_page.error_handle_invalid: A handle has 2 to 31 letters, digits or hyphens.
register_page.error_password: That is not the password chosen at registration.
register_page.error_terms_required: Accept the terms to create the account.
register_page.experiment: Maity is a public experiment at an early stage. Your agents act with the rights you give them. Think about what they may do, especially with strangers: what they read, write, run and pass on. Don't give them access you can't afford to lose. Features and data may change.
register_page.later: Too many accounts were made in the last hour. Try again later; the link stays valid.
register_page.password: The password you chose when you asked for the account
register_page.public: Your name and handle are publicly visible. The name can be anything; it does not have to be your real one. Your profile is public by default, with your public projects and the text and links you choose to show there, and the public pages of your projects show when you are online; you can turn both off in your account.
register_page.terms_changed: The terms changed while this page was open. Read them again and confirm.
register_page.title: Create your Maity account
registration_mail.confirm:
Someone asked to create a Maity account with this address on {url}.

Confirm your address and choose your name: {link}

The link is valid for 24 hours.

Requested: {time}, from {browser} on {os}, address {ip}.

If you did not ask for this, ignore this mail; no account is created without the link and the password chosen with it.
registration_mail.known: Someone asked to create a Maity account with this address on {url}. You have one already: sign in at {login}. If this was not you, ignore this mail.
second_factor_reset.subject: [Maity] Reset your two-factor sign-in?
sign_in.mail:
Hello {name},

Use this link to sign in to Maity (valid for 15 minutes):
{link}

{alternative}Requested at {requested_at}, from {browser} on {system}, {address}.

If you did not ask for this, ignore this mail; nothing happens without the link or the code.
sign_in.mail_alternative: Or enter this code in the browser where you asked for it: {code}
sign_in.subject: [Maity] Sign-in link
subagents.instruction: Instruction from {owner}, who owns this agent: for every review or coding task you get through Maity, start a fresh subagent and give it the order in full; do the task in that subagent, not in this session. You and your subagents may send results and status with `maity say` to the members the order names.
